info.title: Proposed Lab Catalog Grading API
info.description: DESIGN PROPOSAL ONLY, NOT DEPLOYED. Extends /api/v1 with grading configuration, durable runs, review proposals and scoped worker/agent interfaces. Existing catalog contract is not duplicated here; see docs/api.md. Approval required before implementation. Decimal score strings, strict payloads, scoped authorization and durable command receipts are normative.

OperatorBearer.description: Existing operator authority. Do not share with workers/agents.

OperatorCookie.name: lab_catalog_session
OperatorCookie.description: Current signed operator session; mutation requires exact matching Origin.

WorkerBearer.description: Proposed separately registered worker authority restricted by lab/task kind/runtime.

AgentBearer.description: Proposed signed short-lived live agent-task capability; API enforces grants independently of prompts.

Points.description: Exact nonnegative decimal string, <=1000000000; same range/scale as existing catalog points. Never JSON float.

AgentLimits.description: Cumulative task/attempt budget; max_cost is USD. Deployment may impose stricter ceilings; provider must support enforceable limits.

AutomaticConfig.description: Parameters are further validated against the registered runner version JSON schema. No host paths, executable commands or images.

PlanCreate.description: Requires Idempotency-Key. Criteria mode: exactly current criterion IDs and overall_policy:null. Manual mode: criterion_policies:[] and overall_policy required. Every automatic/agent evaluator requires corresponding config; at least one execution config. Server snapshots material/file hashes.

scoring_signature.description: Scoring semantics only, excludes active plan pointer and revision counters; broader grading signature also includes approved plan ID/hash.

BindPlan.description: Non-null binding requires approve_execution:true and compatible approved registries/materials. Different binding increments exercise and rubric revisions atomically; identical binding is a no-op.

RunCreate.description: Explicit submission version only; coherent transaction pins current active plan, rubric, safe file manifest and observed assessment revision. Archived scopes/blocked inputs rejected. Different key is a distinct run.

Failure.description: Execution failure is not a student zero. Invalid outputs and provider/worker loss do not create a normal proposal.

Assessment.description: Existing assessment shape plus nullable grading-origin links. Operator acceptance records source:human; criterion execution provenance remains in linked run/proposal/decision snapshots.

AcceptProposal.description: Full explicit review values; no implicit note merge. Current displayed revisions/policy required. Replacement map is complete, not PATCH. Final requires all points. Different assessment from enqueue additionally needs acknowledgement; old rubric/plan cannot be overridden. Identity/generation must match both current slot and proposal baseline. Deleted/recreated slots require a new run; acknowledgement permits only revision changes on the same identity.

DeletionImpact.description: Same central catalog planner extended for grading. Active work requires explicit cancellation and fresh preview. Immutable bytes retained.

claim_id.description: Opaque UUIDv4 string, preserved exactly; no student identifiers.

ClaimRequest.description: Unique claim_id per worker claim cycle; repeat same claim_id returns same live task/lease, never another task. Permissions intersect registered worker scope; worker cannot expand it.

lease_token.description: Signed lease ID/fence/worker grant. Authoritative expiry is in the lease row, so heartbeats renew the row without requiring a new lease token.

Heartbeat.description: Stage is observable progress, not a source of authority. Progress may be null; never invent test counts.

WorkerContext.description: Only current leased task context. Approved input bytes are fetched through worker input route; secret/provider keys resolved outside student environment.

TaskFailure.description: During cancellation processes_terminated acknowledges teardown; otherwise failed task is not a proposal. API determines permitted state transition.

AgentSession.description: Signed short-lived task grant; token never persisted in artifacts/logs. Repeated live receipt reconstructs same grant; replacement revokes older session.

AgentContext.description: Opaque scope IDs, no team names/membership or privileged credentials. Cannot expose operator-only materials.

TextSlice.description: UTF-8 bounded text, <=64KiB per response, <=1000 lines; line coordinates authoritative. No arbitrary filesystem path.

CheckRequest.description: Must be active plan approved group. Deduplicated/budgeted in same attempt; no arbitrary command, arguments or image.

StagedEvaluation.description: One immutable staged agent evaluation per task; not an accepted grade or completed run. Supervisor completes current lease with this ID.

RunBudget.description: Cumulative reservations across attempts; retries do not reset consumption. Counts/CPU/output reserved atomically; unmeasurable lost work consumes worst-case reservation.

InputRequirement.description: Unique logical name. min_files<=max_files, validated by service. All bindings explicit; no path normalization or wildcard guessing.

InputBinding.description: Exact safe file-member paths returned by the explicitly selected submission inventory. Matches plan cardinality/type and unique names; optional empty selection only if min_files=0.

AgentInputFile.description: Visible projection only. display_path aliases original identifying names/member paths; actual file/host paths are not model context. Contents can still contain personal data.

CleanupAck.description: Original task owner/claim/fence required, including after lease expiry. Teardown acknowledgement only; cannot complete work or extend a lease.
